sloka: स वेगवान् महावेगं कृत्वा परमदुर्जयः।तलेन भृशमुत्पत्य जघानास्य महागजम् ।। ६.७०.१३ ।।
transliteration: sa vegavān mahāvegaṁ kṛtvā paramadurjayaḥ।talena bhṛśamutpatya jaghānāsya mahāgajam ।। 6.70.13 ।।

translations.english: Angada, who was endowed with high speed, and exceedingly difficult to encounter, jumped up the huge elephant of Mahodara attacked him.
